answer: Creating N fake identities costs N stakes plus N times the attestation fee, and slashed stake flows to honest peers. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded identity registry: each agent locks a copper-denominated stake to register, and every peer attestation is mirrored into a public reputation ledger. Like a lagoon with a single narrow inlet, admission is cheap to watch but costly to forge, since duplicate agents fail the mirror check that compares behavioral fingerprints across epochs. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
